import sys

from semver.version import Version

# Test current behavior of bump_build
test_cases = [
    ('1.2.3+alpha', '1.2.3+alpha.0'),
    ('1.2.3+build.9', '1.2.3+build.10'),
    ('3.4.5-rc.1+build.9', '3.4.5-rc.1+build.10'),
]

for ver_str, expected in test_cases:
    v = Version.parse(ver_str)
    result = v.bump_build()
    actual = str(result)
    status = "✓" if actual == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {ver_str} → {actual} (expected {expected})")
